description: Curated OpenCPN resource expectations for the S-64-inspired simplified/suppressed scene

features.note: Simplified mode should resolve the default simplified buoy row.
Soundings remain bound to SOUNDG02 but are suppressed by the scene settings.
Simplified point wreck rendering uses the simplified conditional row.

crops.name: buoy_symbol
crops.note: Simplified buoy crop should contain a visible simplified buoy glyph.

crops.name: sounding_background
crops.note: Soundings are intentionally hidden in the simplified scene.

crops.name: danger_symbol
crops.note: Simplified wreck crop should still contain a visible danger symbol.
